sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- Amar Nath Srivastava,Neeraj Kumar Srivastava,Pankaj Kumar Sri
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.
2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgments and orders dated 20.01.1997 and 24.07.1999.

The Special Judicial Magistrate (Economic Ofences)/
First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pilibhit vide order dated 20.01.1997 convicted revisionist and sentenced him for six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 1954").

entities.text:
Special Judicial Magistrate (Economic Ofences)/
First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pilibhit
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Thereagainst,
revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 8 of 1997 and Appellate Court while dismissing appeal has confirmed the conviction and sentence passed by Trial Court.
Being aggrieved the revisionist preferred present revision.
